fields.issue: Exemption certificate not applying in CloudTax.
fields.details: Open the customer record, select Certificates, and add the certificate. Confirm the state, effective date and expiration date before saving. A California certificate does not cover Texas.

fields.description: An exemption certificate stopped applying in California.
fields.resolution: The certificate had expired. The engineer entered the renewed certificate and verified its effective date.

fields.details: CloudTax rounding applies per invoice line. Check the configured decimal precision when totals differ.

fields.description: CloudTax reports ERR-204 when rounding precision is missing.
fields.resolution: Set the decimal precision and retry the sample invoice.

fields.body: In SearchDesk, a content source connects a repository to the search index. Open Administration and select Add content source.

fields.description: A SearchDesk content source could not authenticate.
fields.resolution: The engineer renewed the connector token and resumed indexing.
